role: Assistant Director, Florida Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission
stance_basis: letter explicitly states most Department of Interior lands should be closed to off-road vehicle use
summary: H. E. Wallace, as Assistant Director of the Florida Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission, submitted a letter opposing ORV use on most Department of Interior lands, citing damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, and disruption of wildlife feeding and breeding grounds. The Commission's position, developed through their biologist Jim McDaniels, is that closing most Interior lands to ORVs would also improve the quality of recreation. No agency response to this comment appears in the document window.
complaint_summary: Wallace writes on behalf of the Florida Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission that most Department of Interior lands should be closed to ORV use due to damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, and disruption of wildlife feeding and breeding grounds.

statement.text:
Our agency, whose prime responsibility is the management of game and fish, believes that most Department of Interior lands should be closed to off-road vehicle use. Damage to watersheds, plant and animal life, disruption of feeding and breeding grounds for wildlife are but a few of the problems caused by the use of such vehicles. Limiting the accessibility of recreational areas provides better quality recreation.
We appreciate the opportunity to comment on this project. If we may be of further assistance, please advise.
